title: Extremely high CPU usage when selecting, highlighting files and folders
line: Moving the pointer over a desktop full of icons uses about half as much CPU as before.
explanation: Every desktop icon draws two live blur effects: the icon's drop shadow (FolderItemDelegate) and the label's text shadow (PlasmaExtras.ShadowedLabel). Each hover change repaints the desktop and makes the Qt Quick renderer rebuild its batches, comparing the shader materials of every one of those effects, so the cost of a hover grew with the number of icons (perf: QSGRhiShaderEffectMaterial compare and shader-constant hash compares on top). Both effects now set cached: true, so each shadow is rendered once into a texture (re-rendered only when the icon or text changes) and the renderer only handles plain textures.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: cache the icon drop shadow

Each desktop icon drew its shadow as a live blur, so any repaint, like a
hover highlight, made the scene graph rebatch every icon's shader passes
and CPU usage grew with the number of icons; now the shadow is cached.

BUG: 495505

plasmaextracomponents: cache the ShadowedLabel shadow

The text shadow was a live blur, so on every frame the scene graph had
to batch and compare its shader passes again, which got expensive with
many labels such as a full desktop; caching it renders it only once.

BUG: 495505

From 18629eed1db534a533de9b5b6d11dad1ec05c66f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:06:48 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] plasmaextracomponents: cache the ShadowedLabel shadow

The text shadow was a live blur, so on every frame the scene graph had
to batch and compare its shader passes again, which got expensive with
many labels such as a full desktop; caching it renders it only once.

BUG: 495505
---
 .../plasmaextracomponents/qml/ShadowedLabel.qml                  | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/src/declarativeimports/plasmaextracomponents/qml/ShadowedLabel.qml b/src/declarativeimports/plasmaextracomponents/qml/ShadowedLabel.qml
index 4a0191a4b..d7d880206 100644
--- a/src/declarativeimports/plasmaextracomponents/qml/ShadowedLabel.qml
+++ b/src/declarativeimports/plasmaextracomponents/qml/ShadowedLabel.qml
@@ -106,6 +106,7 @@ PlasmaComponents3.Label {
                 radius: 4 * Screen.devicePixelRatio
                 samples: 9 * Screen.devicePixelRatio
                 transparentBorder: true
+                cached: true
                 _thickness: 0.35
                 _color: "black"
                 _alphaOnly: true
--

Each desktop icon drew its shadow as a live blur, so any repaint, like a

BUG: 495505
---
 containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderItemDelegate.qml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderItemDelegate.qml b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderItemDelegate.qml
index 2676ceaeec..80127e3faf 100644
--- a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderItemDelegate.qml
+++ b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderItemDelegate.qml

media.caption: Master: plasmashell does 5.8 billion instructions while the pointer sweeps over 60 desktop icons for 16 s
With the fix: 2.6 billion instructions for the same sweep

review.text: Adding cached: true to the icon DropShadow in FolderItemDelegate.qml and the text GaussianBlur in libplasma's ShadowedLabel.qml directly addresses the perf-profiled root cause of per-frame shader-effect re-batching across desktop icons. Caching only the blurred shadows keeps ShadowedLabel's foreground glyphs crisp at fractional scales, preserves visual parity, updates properly when filenames change, and cuts plasmashell instructions by ~55% during icon hover sweeps.
